services.name: UB Service
services.note: mounted on the core backend under /ub/*

data_flow: Scoring: Blue Team router → V1 (ML) or V2 (deterministic, 11 detectors)
Broadcast: verdicts + graph deltas over WS /ws/live (~1s)
Render: GraphScene.tsx multi-scale cluster force layout + risk-intel coloring
Narration: UB wakes on fraud and explains
ub_pipeline: Frontend → FastAPI (/ub) → UB AI Core → Knowledge Engine → Vector DB → Ollama → llama3.1:8b
key_invariants: mergedData memoized on graphSig — prevents heartbeat reheat
Never call d3ReheatSimulation() before first graphData (blank-canvas crash)
Decentralized cluster forces — no global center/origin gravity
Blue Team V2 is additive/opt-in; V1 untouched
Red Team panel + UB are localhost/local-only by default
